purpose: Defines what the patient sees and can do online: book appointments, choose services, see prices, welcome message and video.
tips: Only services marked as bookable online are offered.

config.patients-portal.section.access.label: Access
config.patients-portal.section.access.description: Whether the portal is enabled and what patients can do (book, cancel, see documents).

config.patients-portal.section.booking-s.label: Booking services
config.patients-portal.section.booking-s.description: Which services can be booked online.

config.patients-portal.section.booking-w.label: How far ahead patients can book
config.patients-portal.section.booking-w.description: The last date a patient can pick in the portal. It doesn't limit clinic staff.

config.patients-portal.field.booking-win.label: Amount
config.patients-portal.field.booking-win.description: How many days or months, depending on the chosen unit.

config.patients-portal.field.booking-win.label: Unit
config.patients-portal.field.booking-win.description: Days count from today. Months count calendar months: with 1, patients can only book in the current month.

config.patients-portal.section.presentat.label: Presentation
config.patients-portal.section.presentat.description: Texts and details the patient sees.
